Name: Queen's Farmhouse 1 Replacement
Author: QueenQuackin
Description:
I'm sure I am not alone in the fact that I can't stand the bedroom wall in the first house upgrade. So I did what any mod maker would do and I fixed it! The only thing this map replacer does is take out the wall in the 1st upgrade (Married version as well) nothing else is changed. 

I have a few mod recommendations for this farmhouse!

I use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/33852]Empty Kitchen[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20537]PIF - Personal Rooms[/url] so you can really personalize your space :)

I originally made this for my partner and I to use but he made the point that someone out there may like it as well.

> This works in multiplayer you both just need the mod
> This mod does not work with other Farmhouse replacers so make sure you have others turned off if you have any and want to use this one.

[size=4][b][i][u]Any issues? Please post your SMAPI log in the comments! I can't see the whole picture without it.﻿[/u][/i][/b][/size]
